notes.attested: State recorded on the day by the run that cites manifestSha256. Exists only from the first recorded tick; never backfilled from a later corpus.
notes.attestedOnly: A weekly archived snapshot lets anyone recompute records, status, backlog, severity, cwe, kev.count, kev.inCorpus and epss.count/scored for that day. rejected, net, kev.added, kev.removed, kev.since and epss.date stay attested only even then: rejected records leave the corpus, and the others compare against an earlier run, not a snapshot.
notes.series: Recomputed from this snapshot on every run, keyed by publish date (and KEV dateAdded). Revises as records settle. In the publish-date arrays (total, queued, deferred, severity, cwe) the days after settledThrough are still in NVD's queue: shade them, and keep them out of averages and bands. kev.listed is keyed by KEV dateAdded and does not wait on NVD, so it is not shaded. settledThrough belongs to this snapshot and can move earlier on a later one.
notes.missing: null or an absent key means not measured. 0 means measured and none found. severity NONE is CVSS 0.0; severity none is no CVSS v3.1, v3.0 or v2 severity (a record scored only in CVSS v4.0 counts as none). kev.added null means no interval to measure, not none added.
notes.cwe: A record carries up to four CWEs, so CWE columns sum to more than total. other counts assignments outside the listed ids; none counts records with no CWE. In an attested row a CWE absent from cwe.top was measured and fell below the top 50 that day (it is inside other), not unmeasured; when cwe.basis is stats.cwe.top only 25 are listed and other is null (the tail was not measured).
notes.archive: Weekly full snapshots are GitHub Release assets. Release downloads carry no CORS header, so recomputing a past figure from one is a curl job, not something this page can do.
